questions.stem: I_sc=40 mA, V_oc=0.50 V, P_max=14 mW. Calculate fill factor FF = P_max/(I_sc * V_oc).
questions.hint: FF = P_max / (I_sc * V_oc). Convert P_max = 14 mW → W and I_sc = 40 mA → A, then compute the denominator I_sc * V_oc and divide. Enter an integer coefficient and the power of 10 (for example 259 and -4 for 0.0259).

questions.hint: Y = Y_W * Y_D * Y_C with 0.98, 0.85, 0.95. Multiply step by step on the calculator. Enter an integer coefficient and the power of 10 (for example 259 and -4 for 0.0259).

questions.stem: R=50 ohm drives C=40 fF. Calculate RC time constant in ps.
questions.hint: τ = R * C with R = 50 and C = 40 fF = 40e-15 F. Multiply, then convert seconds → ps. Enter an integer coefficient and power of 10 (usually 0 here).
